source_title: EAC 2024 Election Administration and Voting Survey
direct_observation: EAC reports registration mail early/in-person provisional technology audit and certification practices; more than three-quarters of states allowed mail-ballot curing and all offered some early in-person voting
closed_stage: formal routes correction audits and certification
missing_stage: individual route use ballot resolution counted status and perceived fairness
evidence_status: official EAC administrative survey; state aggregate
next_test: trace local route through request arrival cure count and voter experience

evidence_status: official EAC qualitative and quantitative synthesis
next_test: follow disability voter group through local access route and outcome
